desc: Player 1's own card from their bar, as players 2-4 have theirs: two players at 4:3, a tap on 1P's bar (the row's left end) opens 1P's card over it (Mario stands still), A on Character opens Mario's partners (the partner wheel's), right and A switches to the next (the card closes for the switch, as the partner wheel does); then the card again and B closes it. Shots: the bars, 1P's card, its Character strip, closed
